chapter_title: Concerning the Interpretation of the Fourteen [Gre

fills.notes: The fourteen “below” are the supporting hypostases that sustain the cosmos; in the oldest register these are best named as abiding ‘powers’ (not moral agents). The list that follows (five elements + five sons + call + hearing) is a catalogue of operative powers.
The context is the fourteenfold establishment of the cosmos by Light-realities; ‘of Light’ keeps the impersonal cosmological register and matches ¶5’s ‘aeons of light’.
This line resumes the enumeration from ¶3 and introduces the second heptad (sons of the Living Spirit etc.).
Underlying sense: they carry/hold up the cosmic load; ‘bear’ is the natural correspondent of spiritual support.
Completes the pair of fathers (Living Spirit + First Man) in the standard cosmogonic ordering of this layer.

fills.fill: as they stand ordered in the prayer
fills.notes: The paragraph explains a fourteenfold structure ‘explained … in his prayer’; the gap most naturally links the aeons with their liturgical/cosmic ordering without introducing later devotional tone.
Fits ‘Seth h…’ → ‘Seth himself’/‘Seth has…’; the next lacuna supplies the continuation.
The phrase continues ‘… explained … the land that is not revealed’; ‘in the land’ keeps the cosmological ‘place/region’ sense (a hidden realm/pleroma) rather than moralizing language.

fills.fill: in which their order is established
fills.notes: The hidden land is the containing plane where the fourteenfold order is fixed; ‘order’ is demanded by the discourse of aeons/praises/prayers as structuring principles.
After ‘They bore up under the enemy …’ the next clause contrasts the enemy’s assault with the incomparability of the Light-order; ‘nothing equals them’ fits the rhetoric and cosmological hierarchy.
Refers back to the ‘hidden plenitude’ as an interior fullness of the unrevealed land/pleroma.
Prepares for the naming of the mediating figure (Ambassador) as the mode of manifestation of the hidden plenitude.
Balances the previous clause: the plenitude is ‘revealed/made manifest’ in the Ambassador, preserving correspondential inside→outside flow (hidden fullness → manifested envoy).

fills.fill: and by their counsel it endures
fills.notes: The close stresses cosmic cohesion by will/counsel until the end; ‘counsel’ corresponds to governing truths (spiritual deliberations) that hold ultimates together.

assessment: Most lacunae are formulaic seams in a fourteenfold cosmological catalogue (elements/sons/call-hearing; sons of the Living Spirit; fourteen praises/prayers). The largest uncertainties are in ¶5 where the damaged text likely contained a tighter chain linking the unrevealed land, its established order, the enemy’s pressure, and the manifestation of the hidden plenitude through the Ambassador; restorations there are correspondentially constrained but not verbally certain.
